name: bloom-fable
vibe: A pastel storybook meadow. Cream skies over layered sage hills, a smiling paper sun, drifting clouds and swaying grass; Fraunces serif headlines with a coral heart, hand-drawn botanical vectors that literally GROW — stems draw on, leaves unfurl, petals bloom with an elastic pop, a butterfly flutters across. Gentle, warm and optimistic; motion is organic — draw-ons, blooms and sways, never mechanical. For brands with heart: wellness, education, community, gifts and gentle products.
